title: [3.3] AAPSClient displays several OpenAps statuses
symptom: AAPSClient displays several data coming from deviceStatus, showing both current and outdated OpenAPS statuses without differentiation.
cause: The display shows the last enacted and last suggested entries, which can be different times or same time, and this behavior has always been so.
fix: MilosKozak added text to differentiate the entries via commits, but the issue remains that AAPSClient doesn't display line feeds and the enacted entry may not match real pump actions.
evidence_quote: First is last enacted, second is last sugested
